Sergey, saw EliseAI raise the $250M Series E from a16z, cross $100M ARR, and push into healthcare.

Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal hits, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Sergey, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Across housing and now healthcare, signal-to-action latency and data hygiene are usually what cap measurable pipeline lift, not effort or rep count. The real fixes are rarely visible until someone actually looks at the live motion end to end.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Sergey, last bit of proof for EliseAI.
